newsitem.title: USA: Saratoga withdraws SEC filing for spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Saratoga withdraws SEC filing for spinoff.

text.p: Saratoga Brands Inc said Wednesday it has withdrawn its U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing for the spinoff of its Mobile Caterers Inc subsidiary to its shareholders.
The company said the previously announced spinoff would not be in the best interest of shareholders now, in light of what it called a change in the company's direction.
The company said it now has a "renewed focus" on its food-processing and distribution business.
It said it has taken action to restructure management, reduce operating costs and eliminate certain unprofitable product lines in its Cucina Classica Italiana and Mobile Caterers subsidiaries.
Saratoga Brands' Mobile Caterers subsidiary is a food processor and distributor.
The company also said it will not proceed with its previously announced plans to acquire the Sant Ambroeus group of Italian restaurants and Global Auto Group Inc.
The company also said it has no plans for a reverse split of its shares - a statement that it said was a response to "rumors circulating arond Wall Street."
